# sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar

A strip of quick-filter chips above a grid/list.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Templates | `default`, `portrait`, `flat`, `column` |
| Figma | Filter Toolbar |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar/sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar.example.json) |

## When to use it

For the row of filter chips above a grid or list: it stamps one `sherpa-quick-filter` per filter and reports the whole answer in `quick-filter-change`. For the same filters in a column, use `sherpa-filter-panel`; for a strip of other controls, use `sherpa-toolbar`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar></sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar`:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "region",
    "label": "Region",
    "options": [
      {
        "value": "emea",
        "label": "EMEA"
      },
      {
        "value": "apac",
        "label": "APAC"
      },
      {
        "value": "amer",
        "label": "Americas"
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "trial",
    "label": "On trial",
    "type": "toggle"
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-apply-on` | `change` `input` |  | input: its source applies LIVE — a number does not wait for Apply, and reports while it moves. Set by a bound source. TODO 107 |
| `data-at-default` | boolean |  | the filters already ARE the View's default: "Reset all to default" is inactive. Written by the provider. TODO 231. |
| `data-bounds` | text |  |  |
| `data-column` | boolean | `false` | portrait: a column, header and all, even over one scope and its parts |
| `data-dirty` | boolean |  | something in its scope is changed and not applied: Apply is on. Set by a bound source. |
| `data-failed` | text |  | the FIELDS whose own read failed, space-separated: each chip says so in critical. Set by a bound source. TODO 411 |
| `data-fetch-fields` | text |  | the fields the STORE answers, space-separated: each Apply asks it once for the keys they match. Read by the provider. |
| `data-flat` | boolean | `false` | portrait: its scope is a HEADING, not an accordion — the column's View |
| `data-group-field` | text |  | the field the Group chip points at (the standard name) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | its scope's name, written by its source: a portrait bar's heading. |
| `data-hide-unmatched` | `on` `off` |  | on \| off — the host hides what Limit rules out, when it is on |
| `data-limit-options` | `on` `off` |  | on \| off — the host offers "Limit to matching filters": the ⋮ always shows, and its menu holds the switch. Written by the provider. Will, TODO 178. |
| `data-locked` | boolean |  | the host owns the state; report, never self-set |
| `data-no-actions` | boolean |  | hide the built-in cluster entirely (host owns the trailing end) |
| `data-nothing-to-reset` | boolean |  | nothing is left to clear: Reset is inactive. Written by the provider. TODO 231. |
| `data-orientation` | `landscape` `portrait` | `landscape` | landscape \| portrait — PORTRAIT is the panel's column. Over ONE scope, the scope is an accordion — its name, its matches while shut, its Apply and Discard — holding Group and Sort, then each list field as a SECTION of value chips; nothing folds. Over SEVERAL scopes (`data-scope="view data"`) it is the COLUMN: ONE header — Save &lt;name>, one Filters menu for every scope, the page's buttons, ⋮ and the search — over one such accordion per scope. A column opens and shuts as a panel does. TODO 425 |
| `data-panel-mode` | boolean |  | a filter PANEL is answering for this bar: Reset, the panel toggle and Filters are hidden, and a `data` bar goes entirely. TRAP T-panel-mode-hides-what-the-panel-answers |
| `data-pending` | text |  | the FIELDS changed and not yet applied, space-separated. Set by a bound source; each chip wears the pending look, as one with a draft in its open menu does. |
| `data-remote` | boolean |  | its source fetches from outside the data layer: a multi-select or range menu waits for Apply. Without it, every pick applies at once. Set by a bound source. |
| `data-reset-on-populate` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-saveable` | boolean |  | the host SAVES filters: its ⋮ offers Save filters, or "Save &lt;name>" over the set last taken with Save filters as and Delete filters. Its `savedSets` fill the Filters menu's Saved section. TRAP T-saved-filters-are-every-scope |
| `data-scope` | text |  | ASKED of its provider: the Query scope it draws and answers |
| `data-scroll-shadow` | boolean | `false` | an inner shadow on each edge its column is scrolled past |
| `data-sort-direction` | `asc` `desc` `""` | `asc` | asc \| desc |
| `data-sort-field` | text |  | the field the Sort chip points at (the standard name) |
| `data-switchable` | boolean |  | show Figma's leading filter Switch, on a data bar: off stops every filter in the bar and keeps its value. Hidden by default, for legacy reasons. Will, TODO 338. |
| `data-type` | `view` `data` | `data` | data \| view |
| `data-waits` | boolean |  | its scope waits for ONE Apply, this bar's: its menus keep Discard alone. Set by a bound source. TODO 406 |
| `open` | text, native |  | a column is showing. A host writes it; every close reports `filter-panel-close`, and says why. |

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `drawScopes(scopes: ScopeDescription[])` | drawScopes(scopes) — a column's scopes, from its source: a portrait toolbar per scope, under the one header. TODO 425 |
| `show()` |  |
| `hide(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` | EVERY close reports, and says why. |
| `close(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` |  |
| `toggle()` |  |
| `setChipValues(id: string, picks: readonly string[] \| undefined)` | Set ONE chip's picks, leaving every other chip alone. |
| `setChipReading(id: string, reading: FieldReading)` | setChipReading(id, reading) — steer ONE chip with a whole reading. |
| `drawApplied(applied: Readonly<Record<string, FieldReading>>)` | drawApplied(applied) — a bound source says what each field that waits for Apply holds APPLIED: a section marks only the values its draft changed. SILENT. TODO 425 |
| `drawValueResults(results: Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, number>>>>)` | drawValueResults(results, scope) — each picked value's own count, by field then value: a section's value chips wear them. SILENT. TODO 425 |
| `drawResults(results: Readonly<Record<string, number>>)` | drawResults(results) — each answered chip's results, from its source: the rows that reach it — the filters before it — and match its answer, by field. SILENT. A chip with none shows no number. Will, TODO 60. |
| `nameScope(scope: { scope?: string; label: string; shows?: ScopeShows \| undefined })` | nameScope(scope) — its source names its scope: a portrait bar's heading, and an icon for what it narrows. TODO 425 |
| `search(text: string)` | search(text) — a portrait bar shows only the fields whose name, or one of whose values, holds the text; empty shows all. The lead bar's search asks it of every portrait bar beside it. TODO 425 |
| `drawPresent(present: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>, scope?: string)` | drawPresent(present) — a bound source says what the filters before each field leave; a chip's menu greys the rest. SILENT. A field not named is not limited. |
| `drawOffered(offered: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>)` | drawOffered(offered) — what each serial-set field OFFERS: its menu removes the rest, but keeps a pick. |
| `drawReading(field: string, reading: FieldReading, scope?: string)` | drawReading(field, reading) — a bound source tells this bar one field's answer, whoever set it. SILENT, as every steer is. A SUPERSEDED chip keeps the reader's own picks for when the view lets go. |
| `supersede(ids: readonly string[], appliedAt?: string)` | supersede([...ids]) — the VIEW now owns these fields. |
| `report()` | report() — announce the bar with no request: its `values` and `active`, for a host that follows the View chip. Bound, each door already asked. |
| `available(defs: FilterDef[])` | available([...]) — the filters the Add chip offers, over the populate() set. |
| `addFilters(ids: readonly string[])` | addFilters([...ids]) — put offered filters on this bar, as the Add button does. The one door, so a panel's Add and the bar's own Add cannot drift. |
| `removeFilter(id: string)` | removeFilter(id) — take one filter off this bar, as its menu's Remove does. The other half of `addFilters`, for the same reason: a filter panel draws its own Remove and cannot reach this shadow root. |
| `groupSets(sets: readonly FilterSet[])` | groupSets([...]) — the scope's filter SETS: each set's chips are drawn together, in its order — plain chips, never grouped (Will, TODO 241). TODO 99 |
| `drawScope(scope: ScopeDescription, live?: () => ScopeDescription)` | drawScope(scope, live) — draw what a scope holds, SILENTLY, from the description the panel is drawn each of: its chips and each field's answer. Nothing is reported — the source already holds all of it. A PERSISTENT chip (the View) is the host's to set, so it is left alone. |
| `allowFields(list: AllowList)` | allowFields([...]) — the ONLY fields this bar may offer, or `null` for all. |
| `clearAll(options: { organise?: boolean; carry?: boolean } = {})` | organise chips included; three events afterwards. `{ organise: false }` keeps Group and Sort, which a VIEW sets itself; `{ carry: true }` keeps a carry-over chip, as a View change does. A field chip is EMPTIED — ticks, op, typing and rows — and redrawn, so an off chip never still names what it held. |
| `organise(def: OrganiseDef)` | organise({ group, sort }) — how ONE component arranges the rows it draws. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `quick-filter-change` | `{ active: string[]; request: QueryRequest \| undefined; scope: 'bar'; values: Record<string, string[]> }` | One reader act, as a request: a field's answer, an on or off, the Switch, Clear all. |
| `group-change` | `{ field: null \| string }` |  |
| `sort-change` | `{ direction: SortDirection; field: null \| string }` |  |
| `filter-remove` | `{ filter: object; holds: string[]; id: string }` | A chip was removed. |
| `filter-add` | `{ filters: FilterDef[]; from: string; holds: string[]; ids: string[]; scope: string }` | Chips were added, ; or a REQUEST to move a field to another scope — Move to View filters, or back. |
| `view-reset` |  | Reset all on view: put back the View's own filters, in every scope. A host may call `preventDefault()` to take it over. |
| `filter-apply` |  | Apply, where the scope waits: send every change held in it. |
| `filter-discard` | `{ field: string }` | Discard, where the scope waits: put back the applied answer — a menu's, its field's; the bar's, every field's. |
| `filters-apply` | `{ id: string }` | A saved set's row was ticked: take it, so the filters match it. |
| `filters-dismiss` | `{ id: string }` | A saved set's row was unticked: the scopes it names lose their filters. |
| `filters-save` |  | Save filters: over the set last taken ("Save &lt;name>"), else under a new name. |
| `filters-save-as` |  | Save filters as: a new set, by name. |
| `filters-delete` | `{ id: string \| undefined }` | Delete filters: forget the set last taken. |
| `filters-manage` |  | Manage Saved Filters: the host opens its dialog, to rename and remove the reader's sets. |
| `limit-options-change` | `{ on: boolean }` | The ⋮ menu's "Limit to matching filters". |
| `hide-unmatched-change` | `{ on: boolean }` | The ⋮ menu's "Hide invalid filters" row, while Limit is on. |
| `filter-panel-close` | `{ reason: 'page' \| 'reader' \| 'width' }` | A column shut, and why: the reader, the width or the page. |
| `data-refresh` |  | Refresh: load the page's data again. |
